title: Paprika Beef Stuffed Peppers
blurb: Bell peppers filled with spiced minced beef and rice, baked until tender.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C. Cut the tops off the peppers and remove the seeds and membranes, then arrange them upright in a baking dish.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the onions for 5 minutes until softened.
Add the beef mince and cook for 5 minutes, breaking it up with a wooden spoon until browned all over.
Stir in the paprika, salt, pepper, and tomato purée, then cook for 1 minute.
Remove from the heat and mix in the cooked rice and butter until the butter has melted through.
Spoon the beef mixture into each pepper, pressing down gently to fill them completely.
Pour 100ml of water into the base of the baking dish, cover with foil, and bake for 30 minutes until the peppers are tender.
